speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic use.

I am confident this is the diagnosis given the classic triad of fever, flank pain, and eosinophiluria; however, I need to confirm which specific antibiotic you were taking and verify there is no concurrent obstruction. Can you tell me the name of the antibiotic that was prescribed for your sinusitis?
